_doc: THE DECLARATION OF CLOUD KG STORE (#1207): what each page of the app reads, as data; Kotlin names no page, no fleet service and no vertical. `pages` is keyed by the page ids of build.json::ui (test-kg-store-app.sh and KgConfigTest hold the two in step, both ways). `kind` picks the page's reader: binary (the fleet apps and their binaries), debug (the apps' debug endpoints), mcp (the search tools of the declared MCP services), console (a GET and POST console on the declared API services), code (code search), cgc (the code graph indexes), semantic and graph (the two CGC tools), phone_apps (the installed Android apps), news (Cloud Search's declared news feeds), verticals (Cloud Search's declared verticals, sources and parsers). Fleet services are named by their ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints id; app/build.gradle bakes exactly the ones named here (and the two CGC indexes of Cloud Search's build.json::search.cgc) with their mesh and public addresses, so no host is spelled anywhere. Verticals are the ids of ac_cloud-search/build.json::search.verticals, whose sources and parsers this app reuses through the linked search-core (KgConfigTest checks that every id exists there). A page whose endpoint is not declared or does not answer says so in words (`missing` is the sentence for the case that nothing is declared): there is no sample data in this app.

app_debug.missing: No debug port is declared for this app in 1_cicd/src/data/debug-ports.json.

app_mcp.missing: No app declares an MCP endpoint yet. The per-app declarations (MCP, API-Debug and API-App endpoints) are the Cloud Store > Access > Apps MCP-API work (#1211); until an app declares one, there is no search tool to list here.

repo_mcp.missing: No MCP service is declared for the repositories.

ask._doc: The assistant behind the AI icon (libs:ai over the fleet agent gateway): `system` rides every request and is never stored; `suggestions` fill the box under the greeting; `mcps` are the gateway MCP servers switched on for this chat (the fleet's public knowledge graph).
ask.system: You are the assistant of Cloud KG Store, the fleet's knowledge-graph store. You help the owner search the fleet's code graph (Cloud-CGC and Me-CGC), the fleet's apps and binaries, the installed Android apps and the web sources of Cloud Search (news, media, shopping, real estate, jobs, business). Answer from what the tools return; when a tool returns nothing or is not reachable, say so plainly instead of guessing.
suggestions: Which fleet app handles the debug API ports?
Where in the repositories is the MCP client implemented?
Which installed apps request the camera permission?
